title: Nutty Squash Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful fritter recipe made with roasted squash and crunchy nuts.

ingredients.name: 1 medium squash
ingredients.notes: Any variety will do, such as butternut or acorn

instructions: Cut the squash in half lengthwise and roast for 30 minutes, or until tender.
Scoop out the flesh and mash in a bowl.
Mix in the chopped nuts, fluffy, nutty, stir, and fry.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into balls.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the fritters until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
